features.name: AI extraction service
features.behavior: An extraction provider interface with an OpenAI structured-output implementation and a deterministic fake, selected at startup by the INVOICE_INTAKE_EXTRACTION_PROVIDER setting through a single factory, producing validated extraction results with per-field confidence.
features.verification: Tests with the fake provider extract every synthetic invoice and match the ground truth; invalid model output is rejected and recorded; the factory returns the configured provider and fails at startup on an unknown name or a missing API key.

features.verification: A fresh setup and a no-cache image build install exactly the locked versions with hashes on Windows and Linux; a test fails when pyproject.toml and the locks disagree; the full check, verify-all, the compose smoke test and CI pass.

features.name: Sign-in and roles
features.behavior: People sign in with a username and password; the API identifies them from a session cookie instead of the trusted X-User header and enforces three roles (viewer reads, reviewer also uploads and decides, admin also manages accounts on a Users screen); the audit trail records the signed-in user; the Docker demo creates one demo account per role and lists them on the sign-in page.
features.verification: Tests cover sign-in, sign-out, sessions and every endpoint for each role (401 signed out, 403 for the wrong role); the end-to-end run signs in as a reviewer and as a viewer; the compose smoke test signs in with a demo account; the full check and CI pass.

features.name: Sign-in rate limiting
features.behavior: Repeated failed sign-ins are refused for a while: after 5 failures for a username within 15 minutes, or 20 from one client address, sign-in answers 429 with Retry-After, even with the right password; unknown usernames are counted the same way; a success clears the username's failures; failures live in PostgreSQL and the client address comes from nginx.
features.verification: Service tests for the per-username and per-address limits, the window, clearing on success and unknown usernames; API tests for 429 and Retry-After against PostgreSQL; migration 0007 up and down; the sign-in page explains a 429; npm run check, the compose smoke test and CI pass.
